title: F1 — Modular Monolith Architecture Rules
description: Rules governing the mandatory starting topology for all Evolith satellites. F1 is the only permitted entry point unless extraction criteria are already satisfied.

rules.title: Single Deployment Unit
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST be deployed as a single artifact (monolith). No autonomous deployment of individual modules is permitted.
rules.rationale: ADR-0047 mandates modular monolith as the canonical starting topology. Premature extraction introduces operational complexity without proven scalability drivers.
rules.validationQuery: Verify all modules compile into a single assembly/container image. No independent module deployment pipelines.

rules.title: Explicit Bounded Context Boundaries
rules.description: Each bounded context MUST be implemented as a clearly separated module with its own namespace/package and zero runtimeshared database.
rules.rationale: ADR-0031 (Schema-per-Context) requires each bounded context to own its schema. Runtime shared databases create implicit coupling.
rules.validationQuery: Each bounded context has isolated persistence (separate DB/schema). No cross-context direct table access.

rules.title: Ports and Adapters Boundary
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST implement hexagonal architecture (ADR-0002). Domain layer has zero external dependencies. Infrastructure adapters are injected via ports.
rules.rationale: Hexagonal architecture enables future extraction by decoupling domain logic from infrastructure concerns.
rules.validationQuery: Domain layer has no imports from Infrastructure. Adapters implement port interfaces defined in Application layer.

rules.title: Inter-Context Communication via Ports
rules.description: Cross-bounded-context communication MUST use explicit application-layer port interfaces. No direct infrastructure-to-infrastructure calls.
rules.rationale: Enforces clean dependency direction. Changes in one context do not directly break another context.
rules.validationQuery: No cross-context imports at the Infrastructure layer. All inter-context calls go through Application ports.

rules.title: No Shared Database Across Bounded Contexts
rules.description: Each bounded context MUST have its own database schema or database instance. Shared database is prohibited.
rules.rationale: ADR-0031 enforces schema-per-context ownership. Shared database prevents independent evolution of contexts.
rules.validationQuery: Each bounded context maps to a separate schema (PostgreSQL schema separation) or separate database instance.

rules.title: Async Events Use Domain Events
rules.description: When bounded contexts emit events for async reaction, they MUST use domain events with explicit event contracts (ADR-0015). No implicit table-polling or direct queue manipulation.
rules.rationale: Domain events enforce explicit contract boundaries and make cross-context reactions auditable.
rules.validationQuery: Event-driven reactions subscribe to domain event types, not database change streams.

rules.title: Maintain Extraction Readiness Score
rules.description: Satellite MUST track and maintain extraction readiness score per ADR-0045. Score MUST be >= 70% to pass Phase 2 Design gate when F2 is planned.
rules.rationale: ADR-0045 defines concrete readiness criteria. Measuring continuously prevents technical debt accumulation.
rules.validationQuery: Extraction readiness assessment documented and updated at each phase transition. Score >= 70% for F2 transition.

rules.title: Observability Instrumentation
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST emit OTel traces with CorrelationId, TraceId, and SpanId per ADR-0007. Logs MUST include structured SessionTrackingId.
rules.rationale: Production readiness requires observability from day one. ADR-0064 defines .NET context propagation; ADR-0007 covers Node.js.
rules.validationQuery: All API endpoints produce traces with bounded context tag. Logs include SessionTrackingId scope.

exitGate.description: F1 exits when extraction readiness score >= 70% AND architecture board approves F2 transition.
